module_goal: Build careful listening and auditory discrimination.
Recognise and produce simple rhymes.

module_name: Letter Cluster 1: s a t p i n
module_goal: Learn s, a, t, p, i, n and use them together to build, read, and spell real words.

module_name: Letter Cluster 2: m d g o c
module_goal: Learn m, d, g, o, c and use every letter known so far to build, read, and spell more words.

module_name: Letter Cluster 3: k b h r e
module_goal: Learn k, b, h, r, e and use every letter known so far to build, read, and spell more words.
Learn l, f, u — the last Level 1 letters — and use the full letter set to build, read, and spell words.
Cumulative mixed practice and challenge across every Level 1 letter and word learned.
Demonstrate independent Level 1 mastery across every module.
Read and build core CVC words quickly and confidently before learning new patterns.
Read and spell words starting with two-consonant blends (bl, cl, fl... br, cr, dr...).
Recognise sh, ch, th and wh as single sounds and read/spell words that use them.
Read and spell words ending in -ck, -tch, -dge, -ng and -nk.
Read and spell words with qu and common s-blends/end-blends.

module_name: Letter Cluster 5: j v w x y z
module_goal: Learn the six letters Level 1 never taught, and use them to build, read, and spell more words — including many common sight words.
Read a first set of common words that can't be fully sounded out.
Read and write short dictated sentences using everything learned so far.
Demonstrate independent Level 2 mastery across every pattern learned.
Hear whether a word's vowel sound is short (a quick sound) or long (says its own name) — the listening skill every later Level 3 spelling pattern builds on.
Read and spell words where a final silent e makes the vowel before it say its long sound.
Read and spell words using the ai and ay vowel teams, which both spell the long A sound.
Read and spell words using the ee and ea vowel teams, which both spell the long E sound.
Read and spell words using the oa and ow vowel teams, which both spell the long O sound.
Read and spell words using the oi and oy vowel teams, which both spell the /oi/ sound.
Read and spell words using the ou and ow vowel teams, which both spell the /ow/ sound (as in cow) — with no simple rule for which spelling goes where.
